chapter: Childhood, first teachers and the Wilberforce Collegians
title: From Atlanta University to Wilberforce; father accepts a music career
summary: After a year at Atlanta University Horace transfers to Wilberforce in Ohio on advice about its musicians; his father does not oppose a jazz career.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: : Uh-huh. Did you in high school have any sort of a group or play in any group?
Not in Georgia. Not in (inaudible) Guthbert,

Georgia. I went to school to Atlanta University where my brother went -- where he graduated. One year only. And I got some information through some very good friends in Atlanta that Wilberforce University was a better school for what I wanted to do -- among musicians that were in that school in Ohio. So the next year, my father saw that I was bent on this, so he let me transfer to Wilberforce University.
He then didn't have any opposition to your going into music as a career.
No. He saw that I was just intent on it, and he said I guess my sons are just gonna make music a career.
